characters.continuity: Pokémon Sword and Shield / Generation VIII
characters.summary: Galarian Slowbro fights by using its Shellder on its arm like a lance, firing toxic liquid shots at high speeds. It also utilizes psychic abilities to control its surroundings and opponents.
characters.formDifferences: Changes typing from Water/Psychic to Poison/Psychic, changes physical appearance by having a Shellder clamped on its arm instead of its tail, and uses the signature move Shell Side Arm.

campaignTags.claim: Galarian Slowbro is a Psychic-type Pokémon with access to psychic attacks.

unknowns: Exact speed capabilities in competitive battle formats are not standardized in lore.

limitations: Completely dependent on the Slowbronite Mega Stone to maintain the form
Mobility is entirely reliant on floating via psychic power
